title: Thornwild: 6 commits, 2026-10-11 to 2026-10-11
whyCare: [Needs review] Say what a visitor can now do or see that they couldn't before.
body: Compact layout for short landscape screens (folded phones); New Kiri/Pip portraits, redrawn shard/star/echo/glim icons, painted title-menu…; Painted HUD icons, hats, scarves, seed coin and seed pod from the Grok art;…; More painted art: ability medallions and charm, scarf and item icons; Painted UI art: portraits, coin, Starstep medallion and Lumen meter frame
